keyset.title: Keyset
keyset.compare_hint: Manbadan faol profilga ko'chirish uchun farqlarni tanlang. Manbada etishmayotgan amallarni nusxalash mumkin emas.
keyset.compare_no_differences: Bu profillar bir xil bog'lanishlarga ega.
keyset.compare_missing_source_hint: Ushbu harakat manba bilan bog'lanmagan va uni nusxalab bo'lmaydi.
keyset.compare_changed: Profillar o'zgartirildi. Ariza berishdan oldin yangilangan farqlarni ko'rib chiqing.
keyset.search_syntax_tip: #category, @mod, $key yoki {modifier} dan foydalaning. Nomlarni bo'shliqlar bilan keltiring, masalan @"Accurate Block Placement". Filtrlarni amal nomlari bilan birlashtiring.
keyset.keyboard_hint: Harakatni tanlang, so'ng tugma yoki sichqoncha tugmasini bosing
keyset.no_bindings: Ushbu filtrlarga mos keladigan bog'lanishlar mavjud emas.
keyset.capture_binding_tip: Bosing, keyin tugma yoki sichqoncha tugmasini bosing
keyset.virtual_key_tip: %s bo'yicha filtrlash uchun bosing; suratga olish paytida ushbu kiritishni tayinlang
keyset.capture_prompt: %s belgilash · Escape butun bog'lanishni olib tashlaydi
keyset.error_generic: Ushbu oʻzgarishni saqlab boʻlmadi. Jurnalni tekshiring va qayta urinib ko'ring.
keyset.error.shared_conflict: Sozlamalar boshqa Minecraft misolida o'zgartirildi. Yangilangan qiymatlarni ko'rib chiqing va qaytadan urinib ko'ring.
keyset.error.shared_sync: Umumiy sozlamalarni yangilab bo'lmadi. Sizning joriy bog'lanishlaringiz saqlanib qoldi.
keyset.error.storage: Profil xotirasini oʻqib yoki yozib boʻlmadi. O'yin jurnalini tekshiring.
keyset.conflict_replace_tip: Ushbu kombinatsiyani boshqa qarama-qarshi harakatlardan olib tashlang
keyset.conflict_swap_tip: Boshqa amalni ushbu amalning oldingi bogʻlanishiga oʻtkazing: %s
keyset.conflict_swap_unavailable: Boshqa harakatga zid bo'lgan kalit tayinlangandan keyin mavjud
keyset.conflict_gone: Ushbu mojaro hal qilingan yoki o'zgartirilgan.
keyset.conflict_changed: Bog'lanishlar boshqa oynada o'zgartirildi. Qarama-qarshilikni yana bir bor ko'rib chiqing.
keyset.auto_profile_requires_world: Avtomatik profil o'rnatish uchun dunyo yoki serverga qo'shiling
keyset.auto_profile_set_tip: Bu dunyo yoki server uchun %s dan foydalaning
keyset.selection_hint: Klaviatura yoki sichqoncha tugmachasini bosing · Escape ni bosadi.
keyset.footer_hint: O'zgarishlarni darhol saqlash · Escape muharrirni yopadi
keyset.native_hint: MaLiLib tezkor tugmasi · kombinatsiyani bosing, so'ng uning tugmalarini qo'yib yuboring
keyset.native_capture_prompt: Kombinatsiyani bosing, so'ng qo'yib yuboring · Escape ni bo'shatadi
keyset.transfer_import_prompt: Birgalikda Keyset uzatish jildidagi %s JSON fayl(lar)idan profillar import qilinsinmi? Bir xil profillar o'tkazib yuboriladi.
keyset.transfer_exported: Profil umumiy Keyset uzatish jildiga eksport qilindi. Boshqa Minecraft tuzilmalari unga kirishi mumkin.
keyset.transfer_duplicate: Yangi profillar yo'q. Bu profillar allaqachon mavjud.
keyset.transfer_empty: Eksport qilingan profil JSON fayllarini avval umumiy Keyset uzatish jildiga joylashtiring.
keyset.visibility_hint: Modlar va toifalarni tezkor tugmalarini o'zgartirmasdan yashirish yoki tiklash
keyset.visibility_hint_count: Yashirin bo'limlar: %s. Issiq tugmalar faol bo'lib qoladi; ziddiyatlar hali ham yashirin harakatlarni o'z ichiga oladi.
keyset.visibility_hide_section: Hide this section: collapse it and remove its highlights from the keyboard. Hotkeys will keep working.
keyset.visibility_hidden_notice: Section hidden: %1$s. Its hotkeys still work in game.
keyset.visibility_explanation: Yashirin harakatlar bog'langan va faol bo'lib qoladi
keyset.visibility_search_syntax_tip: Roʻyxatni almashtirish va qidirish uchun #category yoki @mod dan foydalaning. Ismlarni bo'sh joy qo'shtirnoq ichiga qo'ying.
keyset.profile_scope_detach_tip: Ushbu misol uchun alohida profillardan foydalaning. Profillaringiz birinchi foydalanishda nusxalanadi; mavjud mahalliy profillar tiklanadi. Umumiy profillar mavjud bo'lib qoladi.
keyset.profile_scope_attach_tip: Birlashmagan profillarga qayta ulaning. Alohida profillaringiz keyinroq uchun saqlanadi.
keyset.profile_scope_detached: Ushbu misol uchun alohida profillar yoqilgan
keyset.themes_empty: Save your current colors as a theme.
keyset.themes_exported: Theme exported to %s and copied to the clipboard.
keyset.themes_import_hint: Import theme JSON from the clipboard, or place a theme file in %s.
keyset.themes_no_import: No theme JSON found in the clipboard or transfer folder.
keyset.preview_scroll_hint: Drag the bar to view the rest of the keyboard
keyset.legend_fn_hint: Fn is controlled by the keyboard hardware. It is shown for reference and cannot be bound separately.
keyset.keyboard_fn_hint: Fn is controlled by the keyboard hardware. It is shown for reference and cannot be bound separately.
keyset.appearance_mouse_body_hint: Color of the top and side mouse shell. Button colors follow their binding state.
keyset.bottom_hint: Select a key, then move it left or right.
keyset.bottom_fit_hint: Other key widths adjust to fit. Click the width to restore Auto.
keyset.section_hidden_tip: This section is hidden. Use + to restore it. Its hotkeys still work in game.
keyset.section_unbind_prompt: Are you sure you want to unbind all keys in "%1$s"? This will clear bindings for all %2$s actions in the current profile, including actions outside the current search. You can undo this change.
keyset.section_unbind_title: Unbind all keys in this section?
keyset.themes_copy_hint: Copy this resource-pack theme to your saved themes to edit it independently.
keyset.themes_copied: Theme copied to your saved themes.
